info.title: aktujo
info.description: The open API of aktujo: your documents, kept safe – end to end.

put.summary: Gives this device a name people read – the other members of a space see it.

post.summary: Asks to join a space with an invitation; its documents arrive once a device that may manage it added this one.
Brings a space back to this device with its recovery code, when no other device of it is left.
Finds documents: with words, the best hits first; without, the newest first.

put.summary: Gives a space a new name.

post.summary:
Adds a file as a new document – the bytes as the body, its media type as `Content-Type`. The same bytes twice
in a space are one document.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name the file came with.

200.description: the same bytes were there already

get.summary: A document with everything about it.

put.summary: Confirms the value of a field.

delete.summary: Empties a field: its confirmed value and its suggestion.

put.summary: Confirms the kind of a document – or that it has none.

post.summary: Adds a label to a document.

delete.summary: Takes a label off a document.

post.summary: Takes a document out of the bin.

get.summary: The text read from the newest version, page by page.

404.description: no document, or not read yet

put.summary: Gives a document a new title.

post.summary: Puts a document in the bin – nothing is deleted.
Adds a file as the newest version of a document – the bytes as the body, its media type as `Content-Type`.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name the file came with.

get.summary: The file of a version, with its media type.

post.summary: An invitation for another device – the person's own or someone else's – with what it may do, good for a day.
Takes over kinds – a template, or the kinds of another space – replacing those with the same identity.

get.summary: The kinds of documents a space has – none until someone defines or imports them.

post.summary: Adds a kind with a name; its identity is made from the name.

put.summary: Defines a kind anew – its name, fields and rules; the whole definition replaces the one before.

delete.summary: Removes a kind. Documents keep it as their kind.

get.summary: The labels used in a space, with how many documents outside the bin have each.
The members of a synchronised space, as its relay lists them.

delete.summary: Removes a member by its identity; it gets nothing written after.

post.summary: Starts synchronising a space through a relay; answers with its recovery code, which is shown only now.

get.summary: What this program is and can do.

document.description: The document the file is in.

new.description: Whether it is new – false if the same bytes were in the space already.

BinView.description: Where in the bin to look.

DeviceName.description: The name people read for this device.

added.description: When it was added, in milliseconds since 1970.

date.description: Its date, `YYYY-MM-DD`: the field `date`, or else the day it was added.

excerpt.description: Where the words were found – empty without words.

kind.description: The kind – confirmed, or else suggested.

kind_confirmed.description: Whether a person confirmed the kind.

trashed.description: Whether it is in the bin.

allOf.description: What a list shows of it.

fields.description: The fields, in the order of their keys.

kind_suggestion.description: The kind suggested, while one is not confirmed.

title_suggestion.description: A better title, offered while the title is still the file's.

versions.description: The versions, the first one first.

DocumentView.description: A document with everything about it.

value.description: The value; it must fit the field of the document's kind.

code.description: For a text field: only the first word with a digit (a number or reference).

find.description: The ways to find it in a text, tried in order.

names.description: The name in other languages, by language tag (`de`).

oneOf.description: The latest suggestion not yet confirmed.
After one of the labels: on the same line, else on the line to its right or right below.

labels.description: The labels, as words in any case.

oneOf.description: Among all values after any of the labels, the largest.
The first value of the field's type on the first page.

The name in the letterhead, the sender line or the footer: the part of a line with one of the markers; else
the topmost line of words.
Yes, if one of the phrases occurs – for flags.

FindView.description: A way to find the value of a field in the text of a document.

Imported.description: How many kinds an import changed.

changed.description: The kinds new or different from before.

InvitationView.description: An invitation: text to pass on, good for a day.

invitation.description: The invitation – the relay's address with the space and a secret.
The invitation as it was passed on.

kind.description: The identity of a kind ([`KindView`]), or none: the document has no kind.

KindImport.description:
Kinds to take over – a template, or the kinds of another space. A template file of `aktujo/packs` has the same
shape; other members of it are left alone.

KindView.description: A kind of document, as the space defines it – the same JSON as in its events and in a template.

fields.description: Its fields, in the order they are shown.

names.description: The name in other languages, by language tag (`de`).

title.description: The fields a suggested title is made of after the name, the first with a value of each group.

words.description: Words and phrases that speak for the kind; none, and it is only ever chosen.

LabelCount.description: A label and how many documents outside the bin have it.

device.description: The device name it writes under; none for the recovery code.

rights.description: What the invited device may do.

NewKind.description: A new kind: only its name; fields and rules are added by changing it.

PageText.description: A page of the text that was read.

hit.description: Whether it matched a word looked for.

Problem.description: An error: what was refused or went wrong.

ReadStateView.description: Where a document is in reading.

error.description: Why reading failed, if it did.

ocr.description: Whether the reader could use OCR.

unread.description: How many pages gave no text.

Recover.description: Bringing a space back with its recovery code.

RecoveryCodeView.description: The recovery code of a space: shown once, kept on paper.

RightsView.description: What may be done in a space.

SearchRequest.description: What to look for; every part may be left out.

bin.description: Where in the bin to look.

from.description: The first day of the document's date, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

kind.description: The kind – confirmed, or else suggested.

labels.description: Labels a document must all have.

spaces.description: The spaces to look in; none: all.

to.description: The last day of the document's date, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

words.description: Words, each found at the start of a word; `"…"` for a phrase. Case and accents do not count.

SpaceName.description: A new space, or a new name for one.

name.description: Its name: not empty, at most 100 characters.

relay.description: The relay it is synchronised through, if it is.

rights.description: What this device may do: `read`, `write` or `manage`; none for a space only on this device.

sync_problem.description: Why it failed, if it did.

synced_at.description: When the last synchronisation since the program started ended, in milliseconds since 1970.

waiting.description: Whether this device asked to join and waits to be added.

StartSync.description: Where to synchronise a space through.

relay.description: The address of the relay, e.g. `http://192.168.1.10:8072`.

StatusView.description: What this program is and can do.

device.description: The device name this data folder writes under.

device_name.description: The name people read for this device, if it was given one.

ocr.description: Whether this build reads pages without a text layer (OCR); `false` in `aktujo-minimal`.

reading_problem.description: Why reading in the background stopped, if it did.

added.description: Devices added by invitation, by name.

waiting.description: Whether this device still waits to be added.

amount.description: A decimal number with a point, e.g. `-12.50`.

oneOf.description: A decimal number with a point.

value.description: A decimal number with a point.

ValueView.description: The value of a field – the same JSON as in the events.

added.description: When it was added, in milliseconds since 1970.

name.description: The file name it came with.

oneOf.description: What reading it gave, if it was read.

WeightedView.description: A word or phrase and how much it speaks for a kind.

weight.description: Its weight, a whole number; a kind is suggested from a sum of 6.

word.description: The word or phrase, matched as whole words in any case.
